Read dataset

Source: R/method_Dataset.R
read_dataset.Rd

Import a Dataset object.

Usage

read_dataset(pu_path, boundary_path)

Arguments

pu_path

character file path for planning unit data.

boundary_path

character file path for boundary data. If the dataset does not have boundary data, then use boundary_path = NULL.

Value

A Dataset object.

See also

Other functions for reading and writing data: deserialize_object(), read_builtin_project(), read_matrix(), read_project(), read_sf_data(), serialize_object(), write_dataset(), write_matrix(), write_project(), write_sf_data()

Examples

# specify file paths
pu_path <- system.file(
  "extdata", "antarctic-peninsula_pu.gpkg.zip",
  package = "apscp"
)
bd_path <- system.file(
  "extdata", "antarctic-peninsula_bd.rds",
  package = "apscp"
)

# import data
x <- read_dataset(pu_path, bd_path)

# preview object
print(x)
